steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each input line is matched to its source. A line that differs from its source is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Input differs from its source
findings.fix: Correct the input before the run

findings.title: Total does not reconcile
findings.fix: Reconcile the total to the bank

findings.title: Variance above the client's threshold with no reason

outcome.notChecked: The statutory deductions, which a payroll specialist confirms.
